{{Infobox auto}}

'''Tomato seeds''' are used to plant [[tomatoes]]. They replace {{MCW|Beetroot Seeds|beetroot seeds}}.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
One tomato crafts into 3 seeds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tomato_seeds_from_tomato.json}}</ref> A fully grown tomato crop drops no seeds, so replanting uses tomatoes. The exception is a crop broken by a villager, which drops 2 seeds as well as its tomatoes, so farmer villagers can replant it (see [[Tomatoes#Farming]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/beetroots.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

Tomato seeds are planted on farmland and grow into tomato crops. They can also be fed to chickens and used to breed them, as in vanilla.
